description: Defines classes and methods for RTP media packet handling, including MediaPacket, OutboundMediaPacketType, and ClientSocket, within the Thunder Bluetooth RTP namespace.

classes.name: MediaPacket
classes.description: Represents an RTP media packet with methods for packing, unpacking, and accessing packet data.

classes.name: OutboundMediaPacketType
classes.description: Template class for outbound RTP media packets, managing packet serialization and buffer ingestion.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Abstract class for RTP client socket handling socket state, MTU, and operational status.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Serializes payload data into an RTP packet buffer using codec information.

methods.name: Unpack
methods.description: Decodes RTP payload data into raw audio data using codec.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the RTP packet has valid payload type and length.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the RTP packet.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the RTP packet.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the payload type of the RTP packet.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the raw packet data.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the packet.

methods.name: Payload
methods.description: Returns pointer to the payload data.

methods.name: PayloadLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the payload data.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingests raw audio data into the RTP packet buffer.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Resets the serialization offset for outbound packet.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes packet data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Sets the operational status of the socket (to be implemented by derived classes).
